name: Satori
description: A Japanese mountain yokai shaped like an ape-like man, said to inhabit the mountains of Hida and Mino (modern Gifu Prefecture). The Satori reads a person's thoughts and speaks them aloud, but is paradoxically driven off by something genuinely unexpected.

aliases.name: 覺
aliases.meaning: 'awareness, awakening' — name used by Toriyama Sekien

aliases.name: Yamako
aliases.meaning: Chinese-origin precursor figure: an ape-man of mountain folklore

origin: Folkloric range is the mountainous interior of central Honshu, particularly the historical provinces of Hida and Mino (modern Gifu Prefecture).
